about.title: Los Alamitos Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Los Alamitos is a small Orange County city of about 11,449 people. When a life is lost here, the absence is felt on the same few streets everyone drives daily: Katella Avenue, Los Alamitos Boulevard, Cerritos Avenue, and the I-605. Public records for 2025 list 88 injury collisions, 110 people hurt, and one traffic death. Behind that single number is a family. A wrongful death claim under California law is a civil action, separate from any criminal case that may follow a fatal crash, a workplace incident, or a preventable medical error. It allows a spouse or domestic partner, children, and in some cases other dependents or heirs to seek compensation for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. The clock generally runs two years from the date of death, and it can be far shorter when a public agency is involved. LawProactive connects you, at no charge, with an independent attorney who can explain where your family stands.

items.title: Clarity on who can file
items.desc: California limits who may bring a wrongful death claim, starting with a spouse or domestic partner and children, then certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can sort out your family's standing before anything else.

items.title: Deadlines handled early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but cases against a city, county, or state agency involve much shorter notice windows. Getting connected promptly protects those rights.

items.title: The full picture of loss
items.desc: Recoverable losses go beyond funeral and burial costs to include lost financial support and the loss of love, companionship and guidance. The attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there is no fee unless there is a recovery.

items.question: The crash happened on Katella Avenue near the I-605. Does that affect our claim?
items.answer: It can. Katella Avenue and Los Alamitos Boulevard are among the higher-volume corridors in the city's public collision records, and a claim there might involve a private driver, a commercial vehicle, or questions about roadway maintenance. If a public entity is potentially responsible, California requires a formal claim within a much shorter window than the usual two years. An attorney can identify every possible party early.

items.question: Is a wrongful death case the same as the criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: No. A wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family, while a criminal case is brought by the district attorney on behalf of the state. The two proceed separately, and a family may pursue a civil claim whether or not criminal charges are filed or result in a conviction.

items.question: Does LawProactive charge anything to connect us with an attorney?
items.answer: Nothing at all. LawProactive is a free connection service, not a law firm, and the independent attorneys we connect you with work on contingency. That means no attorney fee is owed unless your family receives a recovery.
